# Command line words

Every tool the command line runs, the word for it, and the values it takes in order without naming them. You can type any part of a tool's name: the line matches loosely, as command search does. [The command line](../guides/keyboard.md) explains the rest.

| Tool | Word | Values in order |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |

| [Sweep](tools/sweep.md) | `sweep` | – |
| [Loft](tools/loft.md) | `loft` | – |
